mapping: Exact source text to EntityNode.summary; opaque source_N names; exact free relation to EntityEdge.name/fact; source channels to group_id; metadata retained as attributes. Native model save/get/delete APIs; no LLM extraction, fake database, or injected search results.
control: native node_search BM25 + RRF, limit1; internal BM25 limit2
treatment: control seeds passed to native node_search BFS + RRF, outgoing depth1, limit8; internal BFS limit16; application only deduplicates union, maximum9 sources
entrypoint: graphiti_core.search.search.node_search against official FalkorDriver and real embedded FalkorDBLite
network: OS denies all IP networking; only Unix sockets beneath the exact scratch root allowed; live TEST-NET denial gate before DB; no credentials inherited; telemetry disabled
budgets: Preserve Lite requested byte budget in observations but Graphiti node retrieval does not accept it. Report returned UTF8 body bytes, no invented token accounting or withholding policy.
interpretation: Native retrieval component from a supplied graph, not extraction/consolidation or hosted service. No generated-answer, authenticated ACL, receipt freshness, market-wide or latency superiority claim. Prior Lite observations reused with their independent HTTP/H2 cost boundary.
